intro: Managing customer onboarding requires constant attention to detail and fast communication across multiple channels. Using Slack for customer onboarding managers on Mac helps you stay organized while you juggle client needs and internal team updates.
tldr: Use keyboard shortcuts to navigate Slack channels quickly.
Set up specific notifications to avoid missing critical client updates.
Use Lazur to dictate messages and find information without leaving your workflow.
Keep your Slack sidebar clean to focus on active onboarding projects.

blocks.text: Customer onboarding involves high volumes of communication. Slack acts as the main hub for your internal team discussions and shared client channels. To stay efficient, use the Quick Switcher by pressing ⌘ + K. This lets you jump between channels or direct messages without using your mouse. If you are overwhelmed by messages, use ⌘ + Shift + A to open your unreads view. This ensures you do not miss a critical update from a new client.
Using Lazur to manage your Slack day

Lazur lives in your Mac notch and helps you handle Slack tasks faster. Hold ⌥ ⌘ to ask Lazur where a specific channel is. It will circle the channel on your screen. You can also hold the fn key to dictate a response to a client. This is helpful when you need to send a quick update while you are looking at another app like HubSpot or Asana.

items: ⌘ + / opens the full shortcut menu for Slack.
⌘ + , opens your preferences to adjust notification schedules.
Shift + Enter starts a new line in a message without sending it.
⌘ + B and ⌘ + I quickly format your text for clear instructions.

blocks.text: Onboarding managers often waste time switching between apps. If you have a question about a client, do not search manually. Use Slack search modifiers like from:@name or in:#channel to narrow your results. If you still cannot find the file, ask Lazur to help you find the right folder or document on your Mac. This keeps your focus on the customer instead of searching for files.

Threads are essential for keeping onboarding conversations contained. When a client asks a specific question in a channel, always reply in a thread. This prevents the main channel from becoming cluttered. If you lose track of a thread, use the Threads view to see all your active conversations in one place.
If you are struggling with notifications, go to Preferences > Notifications and set a schedule. This keeps your focus on deep work during specific hours of the day.
blocks.title: Manage your focus

faq.question: Can Lazur click buttons in Slack?
faq.answer: No. Lazur points at buttons and guides you on how to click them yourself. It does not perform actions inside other apps.

faq.question: Does Slack for Mac support all keyboard shortcuts?
faq.answer: Yes. Slack shortcuts on Mac use the ⌘ key where Windows uses the Ctrl key.

demo.spoken: Lazur, show me how to mute this channel.
demo.result: Lazur will circle the three-dot menu in the Slack channel header and guide you to the mute option.

tasks.say: Lazur, where is the search bar?
tasks.result: Lazur circles the search bar at the top of the Slack window.

tasks.say: Lazur, how do I create a new channel?
tasks.result: Lazur guides you through the process of clicking the plus icon next to Channels.

tasks.say: Lazur, draft a message to the client about the kickoff meeting.
tasks.result: Lazur drafts a professional message at your cursor.

tasks.say: Lazur, what is the shortcut to open threads?
tasks.result: Lazur explains that you can use the sidebar or a keyboard shortcut.

tasks.say: Lazur, remind me to check the onboarding status at 3 PM.
tasks.result: Lazur sets a reminder in your Apple Reminders app.
